rule_name: National queue_count becomes a meaningful Ukrenergo dispatch-intensity variable
description: Before roughly 8 June 2024, much of the recoverable evidence is regional consumption limits rather than a uniform national number of GPV queues. From 8 June onward the queue-count dispatch framework becomes directly usable.
modeling_implication: Do not backfill queue_count for 1–7 June. Blank queue_count is preferable to inferred q1/q2.
source_note: Semantic breakpoint already used in v2.2/v2.3 audits.

rule_name: Ministry of Energy Order No.439 / new GPV instruction effective
description: The updated instruction formalized six equal queues, each split into two equal subqueues, and 30-minute load-block construction.
modeling_implication: Post-change queue identifiers may be 1.1–6.2; older six-queue-only schema is insufficient.
source_note: Official DSO states Ministry order dated 27 Nov 2024 No.439 entered into force 3 Dec 2024.

description: Each of the six GPV queues is operationally split into two subqueues. Schedules are constructed in 30-minute slots; commands can use half-queue increments such as 0.5 or 2.5 queues.
modeling_implication: After 16 Dec, queue_count can legitimately take 0.5 increments and queue_id should support subqueues such as 2.1/2.2.
source_note: Operational rollout visibly applied from 16 Dec across regions.

rule_name: Physical switching may lag nominal GPV boundary by up to ~30 minutes
description: Operators explicitly warn that disconnect/reconnect operations can differ from the published GPV time by roughly 20–30 minutes because simultaneous switching is impossible and network topology requires sequential operations.
modeling_implication: Do not treat a planned boundary such as 12:00 as a guaranteed physical outage instant. For minute-level causal work, widen planned GPV boundaries or prefer execution/telemetry evidence.
source_note: DTEK Dnipro documentation independently states start/end can shift up to 30 minutes.

rule_name: Address-to-queue mapping can be multi-valued and state-dependent
description: ENERA Sumy explains bills may show entries like 2.1;4.1: the main queue can change depending on possible emergency conditions, while the subqueue remains specified.
modeling_implication: Do not assume one address has an immutable queue_id. Address-level joins require a timestamped/versioned mapping.

rule_name: Regulator audit proves published/commanded GPV can diverge from actual switching
description: NERC inspection of Rivneoblenergo operational journals, phone recordings and telemetry found 26 cases across 11 days where queues/feeders beyond the planned/commanded set were disconnected; estimated excess disconnected load ranged 1.5–51.9 MW.
modeling_implication: Highest-quality actual-outage ground truth is operator journal/telemetry. DSO public posts are stronger than plans but still not equivalent to telemetry.
source_note: Rivne is methodological evidence, not a target-oblast execution record.

rule_name: Dnipropetrovsk Admin1 contains multiple DSO execution domains
description: Dnipropetrovsk outage evidence must distinguish at least DTEK Dnipro Grids and PEEM CEK. The two operators publish separate schedule/execution information and one operator's action cannot be assumed to cover the whole oblast.
modeling_implication: Add operator/service-area to treatment keys. Never propagate a DTEK emergency state to CEK territory, or vice versa, without corroborating oblast-wide Ukrenergo/DSO evidence.
source_note: PEEM CEK official channel explicitly exists for its consumers; cross-check with DTEK Dnipro Grids evidence.

rule_name: Regional execution overrides must be applied before cycle labeling
description: The repository loads an oblast execution registry but the inspected Events.schedule_cycles path labels planned-outage cycles from the national planned schedule's event_id and queue_count. Therefore cancellation, emergency override and early/partial restoration evidence can remain audit-only unless explicitly overlaid.
modeling_implication: Construct an effective_outage_state keyed by time × admin1 × operator. Precedence: verified execution action/physical state > final operator schedule > national dispatch. reported_at observations create censored bounds, not exact effective times.
source_note: Code audit of Config.load_oblast_execution_registry, Events.__init__, Events.schedule_cycles and Experiment A call path.

rule_name: Publication/index timestamps are not execution timestamps unless the body explicitly says so
description: Public web and Telegram mirrors can expose publication/edit/index timestamps whose timezone and operational semantics are not guaranteed. A timestamp shown next to a post must not be copied into effective_time merely because it is minute-resolved.
modeling_implication: Priority: explicit action time in message body > independently corroborated operator action time > reported_at/cancelled_by publication bound. Never infer a physical switching minute by applying a guessed +2/+3 timezone conversion to a mirror timestamp.
source_note: Introduced after cross-checking DTEK/Sumy Telegram mirrors against dated local and national reporting.

rule_name: Separate 17-Sep recovery states from 18-Sep new attacks
description: On 17 Sep partial physical restoration is exact at 02:26 and 03:11, while 281,072 customers remain off at 07:00. On 18 Sep new attacks again hit energy/critical infrastructure and create new outages, including a 22:03 critical-infrastructure de-energization.
modeling_implication: Do not use one continuous outage_start/outage_end interval from 17 Sep through 18 Sep. Build at least two attack episodes and keep recovery transitions between them.
source_note: Directly affects the repository's current coarse 04:00 UTC Sumy anchor semantics.

rule_name: A day/recovery episode may contain multiple emergency activations separated by normal or GPV states
description: Examples: Sumy 22 Oct has morning GAV, exact 16:00 return to GPV, then a new 18:57 GAV; the post-17-Nov recovery is interrupted by a new 21-Nov emergency episode.
modeling_implication: Use ordered state transitions rather than one open interval per date. An explicit cancel/return transition closes only that episode, not every later emergency action on the same date.

rule_name: 24-Jul q0 is region-specific and starts mid-morning, not at 00:00 nationwide
description: Ukrenergo cancelled outages 09:30–16:00 for Sumy/Kharkiv/Dnipropetrovsk and other regions; Odesa DSO states 08:25–18:00 while the broad Ukrenergo group states 08:20–18:00.
modeling_implication: Exclude the old 00:00–16:00 national q0 row. Use region/operator-specific cancellation windows and preserve the Odesa five-minute source discrepancy.
